title: Number Patterns and Missing Values
introduction: Develop Primary 3 skills in number patterns and missing values.
definition: A sequence follows an ordering rule. Rules may involve repeated addition, subtraction, multiplication or alternating steps. Use the stated rule or a simple consistent rule to find missing terms.

exercises.question: 2, 5, 7, 10, 12, ? (alternate +3,+2)
exercises.solution: The last step was +2, so next is +3: 12 + 3 = 15.
